title: Prospect propensity mapping & model failure cost curves
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: build a repeatable artifact that combines customer prospect propensity (likelihood to adopt Redwood inference offerings) with a granular chart of model failure modes and their estimated downstream cost to customers. This artifact will be used by sales, solutions, and PM to prioritize which open models and fallback strategies we should prioritize in the roadmap and procurement. Scope: sample of 6 vertical buyer personas (SaaS PLG, FinServ analytics, Healthtech RAG, Enterprise search, Retail personalization, Platform teams) + 8 candidate model variants and 4 fallback strategies (quantized variants, smaller context models, cache-first routing, hybrid-hosted/dedicated flows). Deliverable: a two-part deliverable: 1) a scored prospect-propensity matrix that maps buyer persona -> features (latency tolerance, cost sensitivity, compliance needs, RAG SLO) and assigns adoption-propensity scores; 2) a model-failure-cost curve workbook estimating incremental dollar and latency impact per 1k requests for each failure mode (e.g., hallucination, timeouts, increased latency under load, token blowup on prompts). The workbook will include recommended mitigation levers (retry policy, model variant fallback, prompt truncation, KV cache warmup).
acceptance_criteria: A Confluence artifact exists with the prospect-propensity matrix and documented assumptions for each persona
Model-failure-cost curves produced in a shared Google Sheet with cell-level assumptions and sensitivity knobs
Prioritized list of 6 recommend actions (procure, onboard, quantize, build fallback) with expected ROI estimate and confidence band
Stakeholders (Sales lead, Solutions Eng, Research lead) have provided review comments and sign-off in the doc
A one-page executive summary and slide deck created for GTM and engineering planning

Finalize recommendation and circulate to Execs + Solutions for procurement planning
